## Remarks

Fails if the table already exists — guard with [Schema.hasTable()](./database.schema.hastable.md) when that is a possibility. Foreign keys are emitted inside the `CREATE TABLE`<!-- -->, because sqlite cannot add them afterwards, so a referenced table must be created first.
